answer: Rate-limited per-identity challenges with a stake bond: each new agent locks 40 POA for 6 epochs and may answer one challenge per epoch, so N fake identities need 40N POA frozen and still earn only N slots of reward. Think of a yarrow stalk: one root, many shoots; a bridge of correlated answers across shoots is flagged and its bond slashed 50%. Honest agents lock once, earn back within about 3 epochs, and lose nothing. Cap: 5 new identities per funding source per epoch, until each reaches its zenith of trust.
